name: עַזָּה
summary: Gaza is a city that Genesis uses to mark a limit of Canaanite territory, on the way toward Gerar. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The boundary description gives the direction toward Gerar and then its limit, עַד עַזָּה, “as far as Gaza.”

note: Moved from the former word entry `3azzaah` (old root key עזה). Its tie to עזז “be strong” is not shown.
